intro: Doras is the Horde's chief Wind Rider Master in Orgrimmar, perched high upon the wooden tower overlooking the Valley of Strength. He oversees the capital's wyverns, dispatching couriers, scouts, and travelers across Kalimdor.

p: Perched on the wooden platform above the Valley of Strength, Doras tends the winged predators known as wind riders or wyverns. Since the Horde settled Durotar, these cunning, leathery-winged beasts have become the backbone of Horde communication and transit across Kalimdor. Doras manages their care, pairing resting mounts with riders and ensuring critical messages and reinforcements reach remote outposts like the Crossroads, Thunder Bluff, and settlements deep in Ashenvale or Dustwallow Marsh.
